transcriber_notes: niViz chart saved as SVG; coordinates read from the vector data (rendered in Chromium with the embedded snow-symbol font to check the glyphs: e = □ FC, i = ▬ filled rectangle IF, c = / DF). Height axis 0 at y 447 and 50 cm at y 204 (4.86 px/cm); hardness polygons step at 39.0, 34.0, 22.0 and 21.0 cm, matching the table rows (the thin 22-21 cm row is drawn taller with a slanted leader). Hardness from the R column (1, 4, 2, 5, 2), matching the bar ends on the hand-hardness axis (F 333, 4F 309, 1F 264, P 189, K 39). Temperature drawn as a line without point markers: its break points every 10 cm are recorded (15 px per degree, 0 at the axis). The CT23 BRK arrow points at 40 cm. Lemons columns recorded in the layer comments. No density column; θ (moisture) column blank.
